Hi Priya / Devon,

Quick answers from the Marketplace side:
- Trial length: Marketplace supports free trials but enforcement of per-account token limits is not a native Marketplace feature. If ACME needs strict per-account rate limits, the common pattern is to (a) use a Marketplace trial for time-based access and enforce per-account rate limits at the vendor (ACME) side via API keys, or (b) use a Private Offer with contract terms that specify usage caps and billing rules.
- Private Offer flow: supports custom terms and is the recommended route if you need billing/usage guarantees or explicit per-customer caps. That will require a Private Offer form + DocuSign for any special terms.
- AMI/ECR: you can provide AMI or container image refs in the listing; we will validate tags during the submission checklist.

If helpful, I can open a Marketplace intake ticket to lock in whether ACME should start with a public trial or go straight to Private Offer. I put a screenshot of the trial configuration console in the attached (trial-config-screenshot.png) for reference.

Sara Evans
AWS Marketplace Partner Manager
sara.evans@amazon.com
